digest.component_or_area: external integration test harness and CI workflow for LLM provider matrix
propositions: Scorer must reproduce exact golden-count results on committed E2 fixture replies under both current and new parsers
Missing API credential cells must record as unmeasured and exit 0 without failing the job
Per-run call budget cap (default 300) must be enforced before any network calls and refuse to start if exceeded
Workflow dispatch job must be registered in workflow naming table and inherit Git version floor requirements
Layout-class rates (prose, fenced, multi-object, quoted-JSON) must be deterministically scored and captured as artifacts
